bench.code:
(let [instance (#'seon.mcp/instance @seon.operator.runtime/running-instances "default")
      custody (#'seon.mcp/execution instance "repl-auditor" 'audit.repl.bench)
      cluster (:seon.turn.loop/cluster custody)
      held (seon.cluster.agent/acquire-context! cluster "repl-auditor")
      p (promise)
      thread (.unstarted (Thread/ofPlatform)
                (fn []
                  (deliver p
                    (try
                      (let [mx (java.lang.management.ManagementFactory/getThreadMXBean)
                            tid (.threadId (Thread/currentThread))
                            run (fn [source]
                                  (let [b (.getThreadAllocatedBytes ^com.sun.management.ThreadMXBean mx tid)
                                        t (System/nanoTime)
                                        sources (seon.turn/code-sources source 'audit.repl.bench 100000)
                                        answer (seon.turn/evaluate-sources
                                                  {:seon.turn.loop/cluster cluster
                                                   :seon.db/db @(:seon.db/connection cluster)
                                                   :seon.sci.eval/ctx (:seon.sci.eval/ctx held)
                                                   :seon.agent/id "repl-auditor"
                                                   :seon.cluster.eval/ordinal 0
                                                   :seon.cluster.reply/sources sources
                                                   :seon.ns/name 'audit.repl.bench})]
                                    {:ms (/ (- (System/nanoTime) t) 1e6)
                                     :MB (/ (- (.getThreadAllocatedBytes ^com.sun.management.ThreadMXBean mx tid) b) 1e6)
                                     :shown (mapv #(get-in % [:seon.sci.eval/evaluation :seon.eval/shown])
                                                  (:seon.turn.loop/evaluated-sources answer))}))]
                        {:virtual (.isVirtual (Thread/currentThread))
                         :samples (mapv (fn [source] (run source) {:code source :measurements (mapv (fn [_] (run source)) (range 5))})
                                        ["(+ 1 1)" "(defn f [x] (inc x))"])})
                      (catch Throwable t {:error (ex-message t) :data (ex-data t)})))))]
  (.start thread)
  (.join thread)
  @p)
